name: Ubuntu XFCE Workspace
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y xfce4 xfce4-goodies tigervnc-standalone-server novnc websockify kid3-qt wget xz-utils dbus-x11 && wget -O tg.tar.xz https://telegram.org/dl/desktop/linux && tar -xf tg.tar.xz && sudo mv Telegram /opt/ && sudo ln -l| /usr/local/bin/telegram-desktop /opt/Telegram/Telegram && rm tg.tar.xz
postStartCommand:
vncserver -kill :1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && echo '#!/bin/sh
unset SESSION_MANAGER
unset DB_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
exec startxfce4 &' > ~/.vnc/xstartup && chmod +x ~/.vnc/xstartup && vncserver :1 -geometry 1280x720 -depth 24 -securitytypes None && nohup websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc/ 6080 localhost:5901 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
